definitions.gloss: a group; a party; a troupe; a band
definitions.explanation: A group of people who are together for a shared purpose, such as travelers, performers, or workers. Implies a cohesive unit moving or acting together.

examples.japanese: ⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一団|いちだん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦やって→やる：02980_yaru⟧きた。
{子|こ}どもたち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一団|いちだん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいる→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: A group of children are playing in the park.

examples.japanese: ⟦{登山者|とざんしゃ}→登山者：21318_tozansha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一団|いちだん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{早朝|そうちょう}→早朝：03109_souchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}して→出発する：01832_shuppatsusuru⟧、⟦{夕方|ゆうがた}→夕方：01010_yuugata⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{頂上|ちょうじょう}→頂上：03493_choujou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着|つ}いた→着く：00680_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: A party of mountain climbers set out early in the morning and reached the summit by evening.

notes:
USAGE:
Typically used with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ to specify the type of group: ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一団|いちだん}. Describes a visible, cohesive group of people rather than an abstract group or organization.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一団|いちだん} (a group of tourists)
- {一団|いちだん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧ (as a group, together)
- {一団|いちだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{率|ひき}いる→率いる：10879_hikiiru⟧ (to lead a group)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一行|いっこう}→一行：28066_ikkou⟧: a party (of travelers) — emphasizes traveling together
- {一群|いちぐん}: a group, a cluster — can also be used for things, not just people
- ⟦{一段|いちだん}→一段：08951_ichidan⟧: one step, a level — a homophone with different kanji and meaning

cross_references.notes: Same reading いちだん but means one step or a level
